# agent-evidence-admission

> Reference admission rails for agent execution evidence: four rails (OPA
> Rego, Kyverno JMESPath, Kyverno CEL, and CUE under sigstore
> policy-controller) that admit or refuse a Kubernetes workload on an
> adversarial-execution-evidence statement, each declaring per obligation what
> it enforces, what it only approximates, and what it cannot reach. Every
> disposition is measured by running the rail over the public conformance
> corpus, never typed by hand.

The predicate is `https://in-toto.io/attestation/adversarial-execution-evidence/v0.7`,
under review at in-toto/attestation#570. The corpus the rails are measured
against is astrogilda/agent-evidence-vectors at the tag `v0.10.1`, pinned by tag
and by commit in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. These rails evaluate an already
verified statement; the envelope signature is checked by the engine's own key
authority before any policy body runs, and the README states that ceiling in
full before anything else.

## Entry points

- [README](https://github.com/astrogilda/agent-evidence-admission/blob/main/README.md): The four-command verification of the claim, the file map, the trust ceiling, and how the profile registry is derived.
- [The oracle, rego/execution_evidence.rego](https://github.com/astrogilda/agent-evidence-admission/blob/main/rego/execution_evidence.rego): The Rego v1 module every other rail is compared against; its header states what it does not verify.
- [Profile registry](https://github.com/astrogilda/agent-evidence-admission/blob/main/PROFILE-REGISTRY.md): One row per rail per obligation, rendered from `profiles/*/PROFILE-MAP.json`.
- [Consumer policy](https://github.com/astrogilda/agent-evidence-admission/blob/main/docs/CONSUMER-POLICY.md): The consumer pins, what each decides, and what an absent value means.
- [Adversarial ratchet](https://github.com/astrogilda/agent-evidence-admission/blob/main/docs/ADVERSARIAL-RATCHET.md): The open adversarial-mutation findings against these rails, derived by `scripts/ratchet_report.py`.
- [Provenance](https://github.com/astrogilda/agent-evidence-admission/blob/main/PROVENANCE.md): Per lifted file, where it came from, at which commit, and the SHA-256 of the source bytes.
- [Conformance harness](https://github.com/astrogilda/agent-evidence-admission/blob/main/conformance/run_policy_conformance.py): Runs every rail over the corpus projection and refuses an undeclared divergence from the oracle.

## Rails

- [Kyverno ClusterPolicy documents](https://github.com/astrogilda/agent-evidence-admission/tree/main/kyverno): Enforce, audit, and enforce-with-freshness-window on the JMESPath rail, plus the same policy on the CEL rail.
- [policy-controller ClusterImagePolicy documents](https://github.com/astrogilda/agent-evidence-admission/tree/main/policy-controller): A Rego one, a CUE one, and one that embeds the whole oracle module.
- [Obligation registry](https://github.com/astrogilda/agent-evidence-admission/blob/main/registry/conditions.json): The corpus condition table, vendored with the corpus digest it was read at.

## Corpus

- [astrogilda/agent-evidence-vectors](https://github.com/astrogilda/agent-evidence-vectors): The conformance vector suite these rails are measured against, at tag `v0.10.1`. The projection the rails run on is `rego/corpus_vectors.json`, regenerated and checked against that tag on every push.

## Identifiers

- Release tag: none published yet; the pinned corpus tag is `v0.10.1`.
- Archival DOI: not yet minted. This line is replaced with the DOI when one exists.
- [Citation](https://github.com/astrogilda/agent-evidence-admission/blob/main/CITATION.cff): Cite the specification for what the predicate requires, the vectors repository for what a corpus forces, and this repository only for what a particular engine was measured to enforce.
